headline: AMBER: easy or rest today, and the plan needs a new race block
summary: Today is amber, so keep it easy or take the day off. Your HRV is 48, down 20 from 68 yesterday. That is below the 55 floor and more than a 10-point overnight drop. Your resting HR of 49 and 7.5h of sleep are both fine, so this is not red. The plan has nothing scheduled after the Valtellina block, so today is open. If you train, do 30-40min easy at 142-155bpm (Z2) or lower. Run it flat, with no strides. If you have a bike, a 30-40min spin at 134-147bpm also works. Don't add volume to make up for the last two days. Your fitness (CTL) is 52.7, your fatigue (ATL) is 41.0 and your form (TSB) is +11.7. You are fresh on load, so the low HRV is about recovery, not training volume. Looking back: you ran the race in 2h14 (134min) for 22.1km and 825m of climbing, at an average HR of 172 and RPE 9. That missed the sub-2h00 target. On Wed 11 Nov you ran 24.9km in 2h18 at an average HR of 149, for a load of 138. That was on a morning with HRV 48 and 5.3h of sleep, and you rated the feel 4 (Poor). The next morning your HRV was 44.
flags: Block finished: the plan has no sessions or weeks after 8 Nov. The coaching chat needs to point the plan at the next race before I can schedule anything.
